solutionSql:
SELECT id, shipment_id, amount
FROM invoices
WHERE paid_at IS NULL
ORDER BY id ASC;
notes: 68 of 205 invoices have no paid_at. Several amounts are exactly 90071992.01, far above the usual 100 to 275 range. The schema says repeated amounts are legitimate, so they are kept as data; they would dominate any sum.
